scope: Production atlas draft, shared topology and stable identity, bounded actual Worker messages, real atomic content-addressed IDB commits, preview/edit/undo/backup/fork/cancel/reload. Not full game simulation or release.

legacyBrowserEvidence.scope: Reused earlier PH04 integration v1 legacy-route regression; not rerun on final storage-only optimized build. Frozen-engine golden/unit tests included in final776.

publication.gate: PH00-PH35 and actual device/user visual acceptance incomplete; no remote writes

limitations: This evaluator does not accept the entire PH04 phase or modify plan/tasks.json.
Correct-frame timing is CPU drawing submission and a frame opportunity, not physical display completion.
Computation is nonoverlapping observed elapsed work including WebCrypto waits, not exact CPU time; diagnostic reporting overhead is excluded.
Restore means new document, app, Worker and decoded cache; browser and OS disk caches are not cleared.
Real devices, user visual acceptance, future full simulation and PH05 rendering budgets are separate.
